"""Original camera-guided controller for the one live RoboCasa episode.
Accepts JSON motion/observation commands on stdin; archives every response.
"""
import json, sys, pathlib, pickle
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from rcb_client import Robot
r=Robot()
spec=r.spec()
pathlib.Path('/app/output/spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec,indent=2))
print('CONNECTED',flush=True)
i=0
last=None
cmd=None

def record(res):
 global i,last,cmd
 last=res
 out=f'/app/runs/{i:03d}'
 res.save(out)
 with open(out+'/obs.pkl','wb') as f: pickle.dump(res,f)
 layout=res.meta['proprio']['layout']; now=res.meta['proprio']['now']; p=dict(zip(layout,now))
 pathlib.Path(out+'/state.json').write_text(json.dumps(p,indent=2))
 if cmd is None:
  cmd=np.array([p[k] for k in spec['action_types']['ee_pose']['layout']],dtype=float)
 cams=list(res.last)
 if cams:
  canvas=Image.new('RGB',(640,240*((len(cams)+1)//2)))
  d=ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
  for j,c in enumerate(cams):
   canvas.paste(Image.fromarray(res.last[c]),(320*(j%2),240*(j//2)))
   d.text((320*(j%2)+4,240*(j//2)+4),c,fill='red')
  canvas.save(out+'/montage.jpg')
 print(json.dumps({'run':i,'meta':res.meta,'state':p}),flush=True)
 i+=1

record(r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none'))
for line in sys.stdin:
 try:
  q=json.loads(line)
  if q['op']=='obs':
   record(r.get_obs(cameras=q.get('cams'),seconds=q.get('seconds',0),include_depth=True,video='none'))
  elif q['op']=='move':
   target=cmd.copy()
   if 'target' in q: target=np.array(q['target'],float)
   for k,v in q.get('set',{}).items(): target[int(k)]=v
   n=q.get('n',40)
   a=np.linspace(cmd,target,n+1)[1:]
   if q.get('hold',0): a=np.concatenate([a,np.tile(target,(q['hold'],1))])
   res=r.submit('ee_pose',a,cameras=q.get('cams'),include_depth=True,video='none',note=q.get('note','camera guided motion'))
   cmd=target
   record(res)
  elif q['op']=='status': print(r.status(),flush=True)
  elif q['op']=='quit': break
 except Exception as e: print('ERROR',repr(e),flush=True)
PY
